title: Falafel
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Hara dhania (Fresh coriander) 1 bunch or as required
steps.romanUrdu: -Hara dhania (Fresh coriander) 1 bunch or as required

steps.instruction: -Himalayan pink salt ½ tbs or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Himalayan pink salt ½ tbs or to taste

steps.instruction: -In a chopper,add onion,garlic,green chillies,fresh coriander,chickpeas,sesame seeds,coriander seeds, baking powder,dried oregano,cumin seeds,pink salt,black pepper powder,lemon juice & chop well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chopper mein pyaz,lehsan,hari mirchein,hara dhania,safed chanay,til,sabut dhania,baking powder, dried oregano,zeera,pink salt,kali mirch powder aur lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take out in a bowl & knead well for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein nikal lein aur 2-3 minutes kliya ache tarhan knead ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take a small quantity of mixture (45g) & press gently to make oval shape falafels.
steps.romanUrdu: -Mixture ki small quantity (45g) lein aur gently press ker ka oval shape falafels bana lein.

steps.instruction: -In a wok,heat cooking oil & fry on medium low flame until golden brown (makes 20 falafel).
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil garam karein aur darmiyani halki ancch per golden brown ho janay ta fry ker lein (makes 20 falafel).
-Pita bread,hummus & salad ka saath serve karein!
